Model Application format for prior intimation to the Board or Council for access to biological resources, 
digital sequence information or knowledge associated thereto for commercial utilisation by persons covered 
under section 7 of the Act. 
1. Particulars of the applicant 
(i) Category of the applicant (Drop-down menu) 
a. Individual 
b. Entity

(iii) Address of the applicant

return
